codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly creates 5 Maven assembly descriptors and configures maven-assembly-plugin in sdk-native/pom.xml with 5 executions, one per platform. The maven-jar-plugin is also properly configured to exclude native/** from the main (unclassified) JAR. All XML is well-formed. The assembly descriptor schema version (1.1.3) is slightly dated but functional and compatible. The commit modifies only sdk-native/pom.xml and adds files under sdk-native/src/assembly/ — no boundary violations. Platform classifier strings exactly match the convention in AGENTS.md (linux-x86_64, linux-aarch64, osx-x86_64, osx-aarch64, windows-x86_64). Each descriptor correctly points to ${project.basedir}/src/main/resources/native/<platform> as the source directory and outputs to native/<platform>/ inside the JAR, which aligns with the loader's classpath extraction path pattern (native/<platform>/<libfilename>). The appendAssemblyId=false with explicit classifier configuration is the correct approach for producing Maven-repository-compatible classified artifacts. The Gradle build still passes after the changes, confirming no regression. The verify-pom-metadata feature (completed later) added the maven-assembly-plugin and maven-jar-plugin versions to root POM pluginManagement, so the sdk-native/pom.xml correctly inherits versions without needing to declare them inline.

issues.description: Assembly descriptor uses schema version 1.1.3 (http://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-assembly-plugin/assembly/1.1.3). The latest schema is 2.3.0 (for maven-assembly-plugin 3.x). While 1.1.3 is fully backwards-compatible and functional with plugin version 3.7.1, using the updated schema namespace would be more consistent. This applies to all 5 descriptors.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The 5 assembly descriptors use the maven-assembly-plugin assembly schema version 1.1.3 while the plugin version configured in the root POM is 3.7.1. The schema version 2.3.0 would be more appropriate for the 3.x plugin version line. This is a minor inconsistency but does not affect functionality.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: All 5 assembly descriptors at sdk-native/src/assembly/*.xml use xmlns 'http://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-assembly-plugin/assembly/1.1.3', while root pom.xml sets maven.assembly.plugin.version=3.7.1.
